messages:
Maya Chen: Hi everyone  first day here (Maya, AE). Two quick blockers: I can't access the AE handbook in Drive and I don't have HubSpot/Gong seats yet. Who's the right owner for the playbooks and who handles seat provisioning?

IT Helpdesk: Welcome Maya! Please paste this provisioning snippet into the IT portal or drop the ticket here after you submit:
```
product: Sales Tools
requester: Maya Chen
email: maya.chen@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (full), Gong (seat), Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Handbook-2024
priority: standard
needed-by: 2024-08-01
notes: new AE onboarding
```
Once you paste the ticket ID we'll triage.

Maya Chen: Ticket created: REQ-5987. Thanks! Also who owns the "discovery + demo" cheat sheets and the vertical collateral?

Rory (enablement): Hey Maya  welcome! I own the AE handbook and enablement artifacts. Canonical locations:
- AE handbook: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Handbook-2024 (start with "Week1 Checklist")
- Discovery cheat: "discovery_cheat2.pdf" in Playbooks/QuickRefs
- Vertical collateral: /Sales/Collateral/By-Vertical (SaaS, FinServ, Retail)
I can add you to the Drive folder and share the top 3 decks. Also I run a 20-min walk-through Mon/Wed afternoon if you want a quick tour.

Zara (CS): FYI for handoffs there's a short "CS Handoff" template we use. It's in Playbooks/Templates and helps capture TL:DR, success criteria, and technical contacts. If you want a sandbox lead to practice logging activities and handoffs, say the word and I'll spin one up.

Maya Chen: REQ-5987 status is "in progress". @IT Helpdesk any ETA on invites?

IT Helpdesk: Should be done within 3 hours unless SSO mapping needs a manual fix. We'll post the invite links in the ticket and here. If you get a 403, upload a screenshot and we'll remap.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Maya Chen! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/checklists/maya_chen_1744001122. Tasks added: Accept HubSpot invite, Watch Gong intro, Shadow session with Rory, Log 3 demo outcomes in sandbox lead.

Rory (enablement): Quick tips for HubSpot + Gong:
- HubSpot: clone the "AE - Outbound" sequence from Sequences/shared-AE and personalize day 1.
- Gong: enable auto-tagging rules (Settings -> Call Tags) and add the "AE discovery" tag to your calls. We also have a 10-min "Gong basics for AEs" recording in Playbooks.

Maya Chen: Also curious where the one-pager on pricing objections lives? I want to skim before shadowing.

Zara (CS): pricing_objections_v3.pdf in Playbooks/Objections. I'll DM you the quick highlights (3 phrases + rebuttals) so you can memorize them before calls.

IT Helpdesk: REQ-5987 updated: HubSpot seat granted, Gong invite sent via SSO. Check maya.chen@redwood.example inbox and accept. If you see any access errors reply here.

Maya Chen: Got both invites and access to the handbook. Logged into Gong and watched the intro. Thanks all 389. I'll join Rory's walk-through Wednesday 2pm.

Rory (enablement): Awesome. I'll add you to the "Week1 - AE onboarding" calendar and share the shadow schedule. Bring any quick questions to the sync and we'll roleplay the first 10 minutes of discovery.

Zara (CS): Welcome aboard Maya! If you want a post-shadow 15-min review, ping me and I'll give feedback on handoff clarity and signal quality.

Maya Chen: Appreciate it everyone 680. Looking forward to getting started!
